preconditions.description: The number of elements n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a2, a3, ..., an must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of n-1 lines, each containing the final value of y for the corresponding run of the program.

postconditions.expression: all(y in results for y in range(-1, max(results) + 1))
postconditions.description: Each output value must be either -1 or a valid final value of y from the program execution.
